The main takeaway from our work is that
the fully dynamic maintenance problems for k=2 and 3 are tractable, and the proposed algorithms can be used as building blocks for solving other problems in parallel.
the k-connectivity problem can be efficiently maintained in the parallel setting, even for a relatively large value of k, by using a small number of processors.
the fully dynamic maintenance problem of k-edge/vertex connectivity can be solved more efficiently in the parallel setting than the problem of computing k-edge/vertex components from scratch.
